name: fr.deedz/entreprises
title: Deedz
description: French companies by name, SIREN or SIRET, with VAT number; monthly business barometer. No key.

tools.name: search_french_companies
tools.description: Finds French companies by name, acronym, former name, SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits), tolerating typos. Returns for each: siren, siret_siege (head office SIRET), numero_tva (active EU VAT number, null if none), nom, code_postal, ville, code_naf, activite, etat (active or fermee), opposition_utilisation_commerciale, orthographe_proche, url. Updated every night from the French registers (Insee, INPI, DILA, DGFiP).

query.description: Company name, acronym, former name, SIREN or SIRET

tools.name: french_business_barometer
tools.description: Monthly figures for France published by Deedz: company failures by procedure (liquidation, redressement, sauvegarde), strike-offs, filed accounts and company creations, with the same month of the previous year. Counted from BODACC and Sirene, each edition is frozen. Without a month, the latest edition.
